source_user: Advanced cluster case GDS-26: Evaluate GPUDirect Storage for checkpoint and dataset I/O in distributed training. Variant 26 must state assumptions, define a falsifiable hypothesis, name metrics, and include one failure or rollback condition.
source_assistant: An expert answer should distinguish model-domain mechanisms from runtime measurements. Required technical anchors: separate storage throughput from GPU DMA, validate filesystem and kernel support, measure queue depth and tail latency, compare CPU-staged I/O, and test restart consistency after interruption. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer: Assume an authorized, isolated benchmark allocation; hardware, filesystem, kernel, driver, and storage details are unknown until measured, and production data/configuration stays untouched. Inventory GPU-to-storage PCIe/NVMe and NUMA topology, versions, mounts, permissions, affinity, file layout, request size, concurrency, queue depth, cache state, clocks, thermals, and workload/checkpoint sizes. Define the path precisely and separately measure storage-device throughput, host-to-GPU DMA, host CPU use, end-to-end checkpoint time, training stall time, I/O queue depth, p50/p95/p99 latency, errors/retries, and GB/s; use synchronized timestamps and repeated cold/warm-cache trials. Falsifiable hypothesis for variant 26: with direct-path prerequisites verified, GDS reduces end-to-end checkpoint stall or host CPU versus a matched CPU-staged control at the same data, concurrency, and durability settings, without worsening p99 latency or integrity. First collect read-only diagnostics and a disposable-data baseline; do not infer GPU-DMA benefit from storage throughput alone. Verify checksums, file counts, metadata, restart/resume consistency after injected interruption, and distributed-rank agreement. Roll back to the CPU-staged path and stop if integrity checks fail, restart diverges, errors/retries rise, tail latency breaches the pre-registered threshold, or production isolation is uncertain. Report measured values with units, confidence intervals or run variability, confounders such as cache, compression, contention, and queue depth, exact software/configuration, and evidence required before generalizing.
risks: Direct-path support may be absent or silently fall back to CPU staging.
Cache state, compression, filesystem behavior, and shared-storage contention can confound results.
Interrupted distributed checkpoints may appear successful without a restart-integrity test.
evidence_required: Matched CPU-staged and GDS benchmark logs
